---
title: Botanic Garden Maths Trail (S)
---

Welcome! While exploring the [Botanic Gardens](https://www.dundee.ac.uk/botanic), you can use
a smart phone to scan QR codes taking you to pages on our [Maths Trail](https://www.dundee.ac.uk/events/maths-trail-dundee-botanic-garden)
website. This was created for the [Maths Week Scotland](https://mathsweek.scot) 2026 programme of events.

![Maths Trail Map](figures/Maths_Trail_Map.jpg)

There are 15 QR codes on blue posts scattered around the garden, including the start
(marked "S" on the map above, which points to this page on the website) and end (marked "E").
The remainder can be visited in any order, and are labelled with various mathematical symbols.
